ValidationRule.description:
If Resigned is True & Status is "Resigned", Resignation
Date is required and must be today's date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( Resigned__c =TRUE, ISPICKVAL( Status__c ,"Resigned"),
OR(ISBLANK( Date_of_Resignation__c ), Date_of_Resignation__c = TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Resignation Date is required and must be today's date.
